key_phrases: AI business is on track to surpass an annual revenue run rate of $10 billion next quarter
Demand continues to be higher than our available capacity
Azure growth included roughly 12 points from AI services
CapEx... to support our cloud and AI offerings
analysis.reasoning: The earnings call demonstrates exceptional performance in Cloud and AI, with Azure growth significantly driven by AI services. Management shows high confidence despite acknowledging short-term supply constraints (third-party delivery delays) that may cause a slight deceleration in Q2 growth. The company is aggressively expanding CapEx to meet massive demand signals. The Q&A session was highly transparent regarding the OpenAI partnership and capital allocation strategies, with very high quantitative specificity throughout the presentation.
